Teva Pharmaceutical Industries appointed Serge Rogasik as CEO of TAPI (Technology & API Services), its active pharmaceutical ingredients and contract development and manufacturing organization division.
was most recently CEO of Kensing, a specialty ingredients company. He has also worked at Vantage Specialty Chemicals, Addivant, BASF, and Eastman Chemical Company.
TAPI has ~4100 employees and 12 sites globally.

title: Teva names Serge Rogasik as CEO of API, CDMO business
